Playing across different computers?

Online rooms connect through free public MQTT brokers. If that is blocked (or you want a private/LAN game), run the tiny relay script below and paste its address before creating/joining.

AI Tutorial

Choose a mechanic below for an AI demo, then you perform it and the AI rates your attempt 0-10. Or run the full course with performance grades.

Mirror AI

Fights with your own kit and copies what it learned from your AI matches: aim leading, spam vs controlled attacks, spacing, jumping, sprinting and building habits. Play AI matches to teach it.

Training Lab

Fight a dummy with no timer or win condition. Toggle how the dummy behaves, make it invincible or respawning, show hitboxes, reset the arena, or quick-launch a lesson.

          Controls
          

            
Move: drag the left side, or A/D

            
Jump: the on-screen button, or Space

            
Attack: light / heavy buttons, or F / G

            
Dodge roll: Shift (i-frames)   Sprint: hold Ctrl

            
Mutations: bind up to four in the pack (Y), trigger with Q/E/R/T

            
Weapons: tap the top-right icons, or Z/X/C/V/B/N/M/,

            
Inventory: tap a slot, or number keys 1-9, or Y for the full pack

            
Forge: open the pack (Y) and tap "Open the Forge" to buy armor and enchant weapons

            
Map: tap the MAP button (teleport there once you've built the Teleport Device)

            
Mine / Place: the pickaxe/block buttons, or left-click / right-click a tile

            
Teleporters: buy a block for 10 shards, place two, then WARP (K)

            
Dimensions: buy the Ember or Prism Portal for 100 shards each in the Build menu, then stand at the portal and tap PORTAL (O)

            
Online co-op: tap ONLINE, host an invite code or join a friend's world

            
Worlds: the WORLDS button saves and returns to your world list
